description: Find transcripts in the signed-in person's library, filtered by folder, tag, workspace, status or filename, newest first. This is where the transcription ids that tag_transcriptions, move_to_folder, get_transcript_audio, chat_with_transcript and run_automation need come from — start here. NOT the same as list_transcriptions, which takes an API key and lists metered API jobs instead. Read-only. Requires `login`.

folder_id.description: Only transcripts in this folder, or null for those in no folder.

offset.description: Rows to skip — pass next_offset from a previous call.

status.description: Filter by status. Most tools here need "completed".

tag.description: Only transcripts carrying this exact tag.

name: search_transcripts
